intent.raw: Use a small two-lane dialectic to decide whether to add the user-tested Body War ontology atlas presentation to OEW now or later.
intent.objective: Return an evidence-backed timing decision and the smallest no-regret integration boundary without changing Body War or OEW.
intent.operator_sentence: This route authorizes read-only timing review only; it does not authorize product implementation, ontology mutation, Work Pack execution, promotion, release, deployment, or production.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The same passing prototype evidence supports immediate product value while the open legacy OEW frontier supports a plausible sequencing risk; independent opposed attacks are needed.
subagent_strategy.explanation: One read-only lane attacks deferral by proving the smallest viable integration now; the other attacks immediate integration by proving concrete dependency, duplication, or ownership risks. The parent joins both receipts, runs one bounded robot-talk confrontation, and makes the final timing decision.
context: The Body War atlas and its 43-assertion browser receipt pass.
The Body War-to-OEW adapter and its retained browser witness pass.
The thin OEW prototype is execution-complete.
The legacy full OEW Work Pack still selects SWU-OEW-007T and retains later blocked or planned work.
An accepted black-box review already requests focus scenes, directed portals, persistent relation state, keyboard parity, and source-literal cues.

roles.purpose: Attack deferral by proving or refuting a smallest useful no-duplication OEW addition from current passing evidence.
Attack immediate integration by proving or refuting concrete dependency, duplication, and ownership risks and their closure conditions.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the frozen two-lane Body War atlas into OEW timing dialectic?

steps.name: Run the integrate-now versus sequencing-later dialectic
convergence_criteria: Both lanes cite current source artifacts rather than Inventory summaries for every load-bearing claim.
Both lanes distinguish launcher, shared projection, focus-scene implementation, and static embedding.
Both lanes identify disconfirming evidence and preserve the candidate-local authority and human-evidence ceilings.
The joined decision selects integrate-now, defer, or split-now-and-later and names the smallest next acceptance target.
stop_conditions: stop if either lane edits product, ontology, Work Pack, generated runtime, or authority artifacts
stop if load-bearing hashes drift without a fresh bounded review
stop if user prototype feedback is inflated into human-comprehension or accessibility-conformance evidence
stop if a timing recommendation lacks an exact changed-file, dependency, or validation boundary

gates.condition: The exact schema-0.8.0 sheet and Dispatch Spec route are validated, both independent check-tension verdicts pass, and the user explicitly confirms the frozen sheet digest before registration or spawn.
Both read-only attackers return cited receipts, complete the bounded confrontation, and are joined and closed before synthesis.
The timing decision grants no implementation, ontology authority, comprehension, accessibility conformance, promotion, release, deployment, or production claim.

boundaries.contract: Agents may read the frozen corpus and return cited timing attacks only; they may not mutate product, ontology, planning, generated, authority, or release state.

promotion_guardrails: Inventory is discovery evidence, not decision authority.
The dispatch returns a timing recommendation and grants no implementation authority.
Body War and OEW remain candidate-local; release admission is not granted.
